CustomField.description: Total FOREX component of the tour including discounts, additional cost, optional tour cost. This is in FOREX without conversion to INR and excluding any taxes.
CustomField.formula: CASE( Booking_Status__c, "Approved", ((Tour_Plan__r.Cost_in_Forex__c + FOREX_Component__c ) - FOREX_Component_Reduction__c), "Rejected", (Tour_Plan__r.Cost_in_Forex__c + FOREX_Component__c ), "Send for approval", (Tour_Plan__r.Cost_in_Forex__c + FOREX_Component__c ), 0)
CustomField.label: Total FOREX
